issues.reason: The top-level (Member sk_lantern_1 lantern) is licensed — indeed required — by sentences 4-7, whose anaphoric definite "the lantern" reuses that witness (Coreference & anaphora: "an anaphoric definite re-mentioning an already-minted witness reuses that witness") and whose clauses assert the lantern's existence, while Names and casing bars an untyped referent symbol from appearing at all; and a conjunct of a strength-0.0 (And …) is not an independently asserted atom, so no atom is double-counted.

gaps_confirmed: season expressions have no Time term: the granularity list is Year/Month/Day/Weekday/Hour/Minute plus deictic and day-part constants, so "the late summer of Year 1" can only be a bare symbol that does not compose with (Year 1)

a temporal adjunct naming a countable occasion ("on the first night of her apprenticeship") has no licensed carrier: the Time value slot is defined for structured calendar terms, deictic constants and day-parts, and During is restricted to during/while/throughout, so an entity witness in the Time slot is the only route left

Ordinal's scale slot is defined as the associated event or an explicit "-est" dimension, and a ranked time-period NP ("the first night of her apprenticeship") supplies neither, nor any way to carry the ordering's domain (the apprenticeship)
new_gaps: an anaphoric definite in a later sentence picking up an indefinite that was introduced only inside a strength-0 denial ("did not light a lantern" … "the lantern"): the projection rule seals the indefinite's typing inside the bundle, but the later mention puts the witness at top level where an untyped symbol is barred — the instruction set does not say whether the typing is then re-emitted at top level, minted as a fresh witness, or something else, and a licensed form would need to say what asserts the referent's existence once a later sentence presupposes it
notes: The improvisations in gap territory (late_summer on Time, the night witness on Time, night in Ordinal's scale slot) each emit only atoms true of the passage and well-typed in arity, so the calibration line keeps them acceptable. Negation scope, definite-referent projection, the Cliff Path name plus separate kind atom, leather_case/mire_essence genus-only decomposition, CoAgent, Start/End and the definite-plural group are all by the book.
